name: Taunton (United States)
description: The Liberty and Union Flag: a British red ensign with the Union Flag in the canton, defaced with the words LIBERTY AND UNION in white across the lower part.
history: Taunton is the county seat of Bristol County, Massachusetts. The flag reproduces the Liberty and Union Flag raised by the Sons of Liberty on a liberty pole on Taunton Green on 21 October 1774, as described in the Boston Evening Post; the city officially adopted it in 1974 for the bicentennial of the flag-raising.
